name: Collateral
definition: Assets pledged by a debtor to secure a loan or an exposure and subject to seizure in the event of default.

CollateralAmount.name: Collateral Amount
CollateralAmount.definition: Value of the collateral as an amount.

BaseCurrencyAmount.name: Base Currency Amount
BaseCurrencyAmount.definition: Value of the collateral in the currency used for reporting.

CollateralPurpose.name: Collateral Purpose
CollateralPurpose.definition: Specifies whether the collateral has been posted against the variation margin or the segregated independent amount.

CollateralOwnership.name: Collateral Ownership
CollateralOwnership.definition: Specifies who is the owner of the collateral.

CollateralDeliveryMethod.name: Collateral Delivery Method
CollateralDeliveryMethod.definition: Specifies whether the collateral is subject to a title transfer collateral arrangement, a securities interest collateral arrangement, or a securities interest with the right of use.

CollateralQualityType.name: Collateral Quality Type
CollateralQualityType.definition: Risk classification of the security used as collateral.

DeliveryByValue.name: Delivery By Value
DeliveryByValue.definition: Specifies whether the transaction was settled using the Delivery-by-Value (DBV) mechanism.

Valuation.name: Valuation
Valuation.definition: Valuation process of specific collateral elements.

CollateralBalance.name: Collateral Balance
CollateralBalance.definition: Collateral balance which contain specific collateral elements.

CollateralAccount.name: Collateral Account
CollateralAccount.definition: Account from or to which collateral is delivered.

CollateralManagement.name: Collateral Management
CollateralManagement.definition: Series of processes which are related to the collateral processes.

CollateralPartyRole.name: Collateral Party Role
CollateralPartyRole.definition: Specifies the roles played by a party in the context of collateral processes.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Specifies the status of the collateral or of an event related to collateral.

AssetHolding.name: Asset Holding
AssetHolding.definition: Specifies the securities or physical entities given as collateral.

VariationMarginAssetHolding.name: Variation Margin Asset Holding
VariationMarginAssetHolding.definition: Specifies in terms of value and quantity the assets held as collateral against the variation margin.

SegregatedIndependentAmountAssetHolding.name: Segregated Independent Amount Asset Holding
SegregatedIndependentAmountAssetHolding.definition: Specifies in terms of value and quantity the assets held as collateral against the segregated independent amount.

CollateralAgreement.name: Collateral Agreement
CollateralAgreement.definition: Collateral agreement which governs the collateral.

RelatedCollateralSubstitution.name: Related Collateral Substitution
RelatedCollateralSubstitution.definition: Collateral substitution for which new collateral is replacing the returned one.

CollateralReinvestment.name: Collateral Reinvestment
CollateralReinvestment.definition: Provides details on the type of the cash reinvestment in a given currency and on the cash reinvestment rate.
